svg.title: CME Globex feeds the existing IB Gateway. New: the vertex-history service holds 4 tick-by-tick streams and one ring per symbol, with the quote-rule side set on arrival, and serves GET /tape. The flow collector in vertex-web reads it every 60 s and writes Postgres. The /flow control panel shows the futures state and the agreement. Never: orders, account data, new paid data.
svg.text: Streamed ES and NQ tape: data flow
